display_name: MILKR物理支持留出选择：单RX全K/N先导
description: R12以当前支持集外层物理fold选择权重强度，fold训练估计权重/核/系数，全部支持样本恰好留出一次。固定策略先P01/MIX01/1-1全部16KN，与同输入R9C控制配对；先导不等于目标完成。

data.representation: eq1 first256 float64 raw -> original FP32 unit-RMS -> fixed practical residual/post_sync/no additional EQ
data.split_id: read exact existing K/N split IDs
data.source_target_overlap_policy: same source physical roles;target opens only B/C current support;query never fit

permissions.claim_scope: exposed developmental research; source selects K1, per-row support selects K>1; no query tuning within run; no blind independent claim

checkpoint.initialization: reuse original full source-only Tri-SIG-TIME SSL
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: existing validated Group1 source contract + trisig_source.validate_done rechecks complete original source recipe
checkpoint.selection_rule: fixed final E50/11100; model seed first predeclared numeric order; no target selection

expected_artifacts: analysis promotion decision after all160 pilot rows fixed/scored

metrics_plan.primary: R12 S0Q0 minus original MILKR on fixed pilot1-1; mean per-cell H
metrics_plan.success: >=5pp pooled paired H and separately inspect all16 K/N deltas; only claim across all K/N if every cell mean >=5pp
metrics_plan.secondary: R12 minus same-input R9C; four strictS/Q; old/new/F1/floor and all16KN
metrics_plan.scientific_source_rule: No source-gain gate for this distinct support-only adaptive policy. Original source K1 rule frozen; real12-source-row numerical smoke only.
metrics_plan.promotion_rule: pilot mean raw H gain>=5pp, old/new macro each >=baseline-1pp, >=12/16 raw KN means nonnegative; then same frozen policy confirm other6RX in a new immutable run; no query tuning

rows.method: R12 physical support outerCV strength + R9C control
rows.seed_notes: split/support/evaluation are fixed existing split IDs and physical complement, not redrawn; augmentation per existing MIX01/physical seed; source proxy seed2026103101

notes: Pilot RX1-1 selected first in fixed numeric/list order, not by historical score. A pilot pass is only resource promotion, not goal completion.

K>1: perclass physical-ID sort then position modulo min(3,K); all samples held once, train K equal across classes. For every strength0/.25/.5/.75 fit each fold only on train; outer held excludes itself from weights, bandwidth, kernel and coefficients.
Inner kernel/ridge conditional LOO runs only inside outer train. Strength selected by complete OOF old/new H (or B old macro), tie smaller; final head refit with all allocated support.
K1 exactly source-fixed R9. R9C control force_uniform skips outer selection and exactly R9 with same current support.
No neural updates. Source known-six used only for actual execution smoke, not novel-class quality gate. No U/V truth or target query tuning.
If pilot fails do not expand or alter this run. If passes confirmation uses unchanged method/code and other6RX; preserve all results.
